author: Robert Miller
text:
I've had six sensors fail over the past 3 months... everytime they read low before completely failing ... they've had problems with sensors ever since switching to the 15day sensors. 
And no it's not compression lows and it's not USER ERROR... they worked fine when they where 14 day.
I don't use my cellphone because it's not compatible with the Samsung galaxy Ao3 I use the dedicated reader.
It's a manufacturing or software problem BOTTOM LINE.
